title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing, default state and documented controls are supported. It accurately distinguishes the roadmap's General Availability designation from Learn's preview warning and reports the differing save-button labels. Two checklist controls lack corresponding table rows, a minor consistency issue.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Take notes control is in Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Take notes home-screen setting at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management "Take notes" API PowerShell Graph setting; "Show Take notes" "API". Read Facilitator in Teams Rooms, Pro portal settings and the XML configuration search excerpt; no API for this setting was found.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in that meeting policy.
claims.quote:
To allow specific users in your organization to transcribe, run the following commands:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The in-person setup links to the general transcription policy guidance without identifying which meeting policy the room account uses.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person notes room resource account transcription meeting policy which policy. Read Facilitator in Teams Rooms and Manage transcription and captions; the setup links to general meeting guidance without naming the policy used for in-person room notes.

claims.claim: No admin-center path for the Teams IsLoopEnabled setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "IsLoopEnabled" "admin center". Read Admin policies for Loop components and Loop workspaces, including admin-center, Cloud Policy and Teams sections; its admin-center checkbox controls workspaces, while Teams IsLoopEnabled is managed through PowerShell.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled is a tenant-wide SharePoint property controlling Loop creation and integration in Teams.
claims.quote: IsLoopEnabled (boolean) | This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is also a tenant-wide SharePoint property.
claims.quote: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled (boolean) | This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The collaborative meeting notes SharePoint property does not apply to collaborative notes in Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Apply Now queues a device-settings job and restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.claim: Schedule Later applies device settings in the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: Learn's setup step for the Take notes setting does not name a platform.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management "Take notes" API PowerShell Graph setting. Read the full Facilitator in Teams Rooms page; Step 4 gives the portal path without a Windows or Android qualifier, while its FAQ separately states Windows availability.
